title: Various Positions
organization: Electrical and Software Engineering Students' Society

subRoleBullets: Maintained and enhanced the UI/UX of the Society's website, built with React, to improve accessibility and drive student involvement.
Oversaw internal web services to ensure reliability and performance.
Developed comprehensive documentation and a transition guide to support future webmasters and ensure continuity.
Designed and produce promotional materials, including posters and digital graphics, to support Society initiatives and events.
Managed the Society's social media and online presence to enhance engagement and outreach.
Developed branded merchandise such as hoodies, shirts, and patches to strengthen community identity and visibility.
For the annual Engg Week competition, conceptualized, wrote, directed, and edited a short parody film.

title: Communication Team
bullets: Led the development and execution of the Conference's visual brand identity, ensuring consistency across all platforms and materials.

subRoleBullets: Assisted with event setup and teardown.
